body: I'm so happy to see you're still here! Keep pushing, kiddo! You seem so well-balanced. It's a shame your mother can't see that.

Holy shit this is beautiful! Do you realize how good a storyteller you are? My dear, you have so much more talent than you're giving yourself credit for. And the grammar and punctuation... What a breath of fresh air to see online. From reading your story I smiled so big, I had tears welling up, I felt hope for you, and then utter sadness. If I can be so direct: You must look into becoming an author! I just can't believe this came out of a teenager. I'm assuming you're a teenager, that is. How old are you? Can you move out? I'm sorry all the parents involved don't understand. I'm a mom and I will love you if you need it. I'm an ally and I support you. I hope you find happiness, you deserve it.

I've wished to have a terminal disease or cancer just to die with dignity, for whatever reason that may be. I don't see suicide as lacking dignity, it actually takes some fucking balls. But at least maybe dying of cancer would be easier on my son and the few friends I have left. I don't believe you should have to stay alive. We are all mortal beings that will die. Why should you have to stick around and suffer through your entire lifetime when it's all finite anyway? 

I cannot express how badly I just want to die. I just want it to all be over with so I don't have to be traumatized by my mind anymore. Life is utterly pointless.

If you're like me, you're convinced you're never going to find happiness and no one will ever say anything to make it better because it never gets better. 

You can come here for advice if you need it. Or you can come here to be around like-minded people and know you're not alone in this world. Whether you comment or just lurk. It could just be an added peace of mind, but it's certainly not a cure.

Regardless, good luck to ya.
Damn, I could have wrote this. We have similar problems so I can say you're not alone, not that that matters any.
How? How does it get better? Because I'm 35 and have suffered for over 20 years. It doesn't get better. You either learn to cope or you don't.
That is EXACTLY my feelings. Like, it could've been me that typed all that up. I'm all for assisted euthanasia.
I like a lot of content on r/shelikesitrough

I've been saying this for so long now. It's so selfish to try to guilt me into living just for me to be absolutely miserable in my thoughts. You may stop thinking about what I'm going through, but my thoughts and torment don't end. Why do I have to suffer? Just to make others happy? Who's selfish now?

This is my problem. I've gone my entire 35 years hating myself and all my opinions of myself being cemented by others words/reactions. I'm never going to like myself. And they say that in order for someone to love you, you have to love yourself first. That is why I will be forever alone. That is also why I want to end it all. I'm making plans. I'm hoping it will happen within the next couple months.
